gemini.title: BGS Borehole Records
gemini.abstract: Point index of BGS borehole records, providing registration references, National Grid locations, drilling length and date information, confidentiality status and links to available online records or logs.
gemini.lineage: Published by British Geological Survey as part of BGS geological data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: qs
columns.description: BGS quarter-sheet code locating the borehole record, such as HP60NW.

columns.name: numb
columns.description: Sequential borehole number within the BGS map-sheet reference.

columns.name: bsuff
columns.description: Suffix used to distinguish boreholes sharing the same sheet and sequence number.

columns.name: regno
columns.description: BGS borehole registration number, formed from the sheet code, number and optional suffix.

columns.name: rt
columns.description: BGS code identifying the borehole record type, such as BJ, OE or SE.

columns.name: grid_refer
columns.description: Ordnance Survey National Grid Reference for the borehole location.

columns.name: confidenti
columns.description: Y/N flag indicating whether access to the borehole record is confidential.

columns.name: strtheight
columns.description: Ground or start elevation of the borehole location relative to the recorded vertical datum.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Official or publisher-assigned name of the represented feature.

columns.name: length
columns.description: Recorded drilled length or total depth of the borehole, normally in metres.

columns.name: bgs_id
columns.description: Identifier assigned by the source dataset.

columns.name: date_known
columns.description: Recorded borehole date or year value where the drilling date is known.

columns.name: date_k_typ
columns.description: Qualifier describing the borehole date, such as DRILLED DATE, CIRCA, PRE or NOT ENTERED.

columns.name: date_enter
columns.description: Date on which the borehole record was entered into the source database.

columns.name: ags_log_ur
columns.description: URL for viewing the corresponding BGS borehole record or AGS log online.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
